'''Riposte''' is an [[enchantment]] added by [[Matcha Flavoured]] that springs the wielder backward after each hit, letting them strike and retreat.

== Obtaining ==
The [[Hepatizon Sword]] gets Riposte II when it is smithed, and Hepatizon Swords found as loot have it too.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/hepatizon_sword.json}}</ref> No blessing or book gives it.

== Usage ==
Riposte only applies to items whose base item is the stone sword. The pack builds some of its own weapons on that item, including the Hepatizon Sword and the [[Cleaver]], while the vanilla stone sword recipe is removed.

== Behavior ==
After the wielder hits a mob, they are pushed straight backward, away from the direction they face, with a horizontal impulse of 0.458 per level (0.916 at level II). A spear lunge sound plays, and the weapon loses 1 extra point of durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/riposte.json}}</ref>

The push does not happen while the wielder is riding, gliding with an [[Elytra|elytra]] or in water.

Its anvil cost multiplier is 2.

== Trivia ==
* The developer planned to remove Riposte as not very useful, then kept it after seeing a streamer use Riposte II in PvP to land critical hits in quick succession.<ref>{{Cite video|id=wavOi0ULYpQ|title=How Criticism changed Matcha Flavoured|quote=you could essentially just keep landing crits uh really quickly really quickly together by using the repos 2 enchantment. And that made me feel really good because I realized okay maybe it's more useful than I thought.}}</ref>
